title: No Gods, No Masters #3
desc:
Rescuing Felipe's mom is finally in reach now that the teens have made it to the station... but what will they find underground?

Our heroes descend into the subway at the 14th St Station to find their friend's mom, but new nightmares await them!

As the government begins to carpet-bomb Manhattan to combat the threat of the giant Amikuk, what more will Felipe, Malik, and Jeannie need to do in order to survive?

Join our three characters for the next chapter of the exciting NYC kaiju epic!
